text: Temasek Holdings is the only shareholder with more than 10% of Standard Chartered's voting share capital: the bank's 2025 annual report lists Temasek's notified holding as 17.00% of voting rights at 31 December 2025, and in March 2026 Temasek notified a holding of about 18%, held mostly through its wholly owned subsidiary Dover Investments.

source.name: Standard Chartered PLC, Annual Report 2025: Major shareholders
source.quote: Temasek Holdings (Private) Limited (Temasek) is the only shareholder that has an interest of more than 10 per cent in the Company’s issued ordinary share capital carrying a right to vote at any general meeting.

additionalSources.name: Standard Chartered PLC: Holding(s) in Company (TR-1 notification from Temasek, RNS via Investegate)
additionalSources.quote: 405,155,789 shares are held by Dover Investments Pte. Ltd. ("Dover") as at 2 March 2026. Dover is a wholly owned subsidiary of Fullerton Management Pte Ltd, which is in turn a wholly owned subsidiary of Temasek Holdings (Private) Limited.
